Who We Are
 VOIS (Vodafone Intelligent Solutions) is a strategic arm of Vodafone Group Plc, creating value for customers by delivering intelligent solutions through Talent, Technology & Transformation.
As the largest shared services organisation in the global telco industry with 30,000 FTE, our portfolio of next-generation solutions and services are designed in partnership with customers across Vodafone Group, local markets, and partner markets to simplify and drive growth. With our strategic partner Accenture, we work alongside our Vodafone customers, other Telco and tech companies to drive transformation, meet the challenges of our industry and ensure we stay relevant and resilient. This partnership is a unique, industry-first model which brings together the best of in-house and 3rd party capability.
We work with customers across 28 countries from 10 VOIS locations: Albania, Egypt, Hungary, India, Romania, Spain, Turkey, UK, Germany, Ireland, and with a network of teams in Czech Republic, Italy, Greece, and Portugal.
#VOIS #BeUnrivalled #CreateTheFuture
 About This Role
 We are seeking a Python Backend Developer to join our Infrastructure Engineering team within Software & Product Infrastructure. This role is responsible for designing, developing and maintaining scalable, high-performing back-end applications and services using Python and the Django framework. Working within a modern microservices environment, the role combines software engineering expertise with client-facing consultancy responsibilities, helping stakeholders make informed technical decisions while delivering robust, secure and reliable solutions.
The successful candidate will contribute throughout the software development lifecycle, from solution design and implementation through to deployment, optimisation, technical documentation and continuous improvement, while collaborating closely with product, engineering and client teams.
 What You’ll Do
Develop high-quality, well-tested back-end services and RESTful APIs using Python and Django 
Write clean, maintainable and efficient code aligned with business requirements and technical specifications 
Build, integrate and maintain microservices and associated data access layers 
Ensure reliable, consistent and high-performing integration with databases and related platforms 
Collaborate with front-end developers to define, implement and maintain API contracts 
Work closely with product managers and stakeholders to deliver solutions aligned with business objectives and timelines 
Participate in solution planning, architecture, development, testing, deployment and ongoing maintenance activities 
Conduct code reviews to ensure quality, consistency, maintainability and adherence to development standards 
Debug, troubleshoot and resolve technical issues in an efficient and structured manner 
Optimise application performance through caching strategies, query optimisation and efficient data access patterns 
Promote software engineering best practices, including version control, peer review and continuous integration 
Create and maintain technical documentation covering code, APIs, services and development processes 
Contribute to knowledge sharing by documenting technical solutions and producing developer guidance materials 
Evaluate and adopt relevant technologies, tools and frameworks that support innovation and continuous improvement 
Provide technical consultancy and strategic guidance to clients regarding technology selection, development approaches and solution roadmaps 
Build trusted relationships with clients through proactive communication and delivery excellence 
Gather feedback, communicate progress updates and support alignment between technical delivery and business expectations 
Support onboarding activities and facilitate knowledge-transfer sessions for new team members 
Share technical expertise through mentoring, documentation and collaborative problem-solving 
Participate in strategic initiatives, investigations, process improvements and cross-functional projects where relevant 
 Who You Are
Minimum 3 years of experience in back-end development with a strong focus on Python and Django 
Strong proficiency in Python development and the Django framework 
Experience designing, developing and maintaining RESTful APIs 
Solid understanding of relational databases and SQL 
Strong understanding of microservices architecture and integration patterns 
Experience working with version control systems and software build tools 
Familiarity with Agile and Scrum methodologies in collaborative delivery environments 
Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills with strong attention to detail 
Ability to manage multiple priorities and deliver high-quality outcomes in a dynamic environment 
Strong communication and stakeholder management skills, including the ability to explain technical concepts to non-technical audiences 
Commitment to continuous professional and technical development 
Basic understanding of containerisation technologies such as Docker and Kubernetes is advantageous 
Experience with message brokers and asynchronous processing technologies is beneficial 
Familiarity with observability practices including logging, metrics and distributed tracing is desirable 
Experience with testing frameworks would be an advantage 
Exposure to CI/CD pipelines and cloud platforms such as AWS or Azure is beneficial 
 Not a perfect fit?
 Concerned you may not meet every requirement? Vodafone is committed to creating an inclusive workplace where everyone can thrive. If you are excited about this role but your experience does not align exactly with every aspect of the job description, you are encouraged to apply. You may be the right candidate for this or another opportunity, and the recruitment team will support you in exploring where your skills fit best.
 What's In It For You
Hybrid way of working
Medical and dental services
Life and hospitalization insurance
Dedicated employee phone subscription
Take control of your benefits and choose any of the below options: MEAL TICKETS/ PRIVATE PENSION/ VACATION VOUCHERS/ CULTURAL VOUCHERS within the budget

Annual Company Bonus
Loyalty Programme
Ongoing Education – we continuously invest in you to ensure you have everything needed to excel on the job and enhance your skills
You get to work with tried and trusted web-technology
Getting in on the ground floor of a technology changing company
We let you write your own story by planning vacations: go for a trip, experience new things, have fun and enjoy your 23 days off 
Special Paternal Program - 4 months of paid paternity leave
 What Skills You Will Learn
Advanced backend architecture and distributed systems design principles 
Enterprise-grade REST API development and integration practices 
Microservices design, scalability and performance optimisation techniques 
Technical consultancy, stakeholder engagement and client advisory capabilities 
Modern DevOps, CI/CD and cloud-native development practices 
Software quality assurance, code review and engineering governance approaches 
Knowledge-sharing, documentation and technical mentoring skills

 Join Us
 At Vodafone, we’re working hard to build a better future. A more connected, inclusive and sustainable world. As a dynamic global community, it's our human spirit, together with technology, that empowers us to achieve this.
We challenge and innovate in order to connect people, businesses, and communities across the world. Delighting our customers and earning their loyalty drive us, and we experiment, learn fast and get it done, together.
